q.en: After using the toilet, in which direction should a person with a vulva wipe or wash?
q.hg: Toilet ke baad jinke paas vulva hai, unhe kis direction mein ponchhna ya dhona chahiye?

explain.en: Wiping front to back keeps germs from the bottom away from the opening where urine comes out, which lowers the chance of a urine infection.
explain.hg: Aage se peeche ponchhne se peeche ke germs us opening se door rehte hain jahan se urine nikalta hai, jisse urine infection ka chance kam hota hai.

q.en: During a proper check-up, the doctor should explain what they are going to do, and you can have a trusted adult with you.
q.hg: Sahi check-up ke dauraan doctor ko batana chahiye ki woh kya karne wale hain, aur tumhare saath koi trusted adult reh sakta hai.

explain.en: A safe check-up is explained first and you may ask questions or ask the doctor to stop. Having a parent or trusted adult present is your right.
explain.hg: Safe check-up mein pehle sab explain kiya jaata hai aur tum sawaal puch sakte ho ya doctor ko rukne ko bol sakte ho. Parent ya trusted adult ka saath hona tumhara haq hai.

q.en: In a person with a vulva, which opening does urine come out of?
q.hg: Jinke paas vulva hai, unmein urine kis opening se nikalta hai?

options.en: The urethra, a separate small opening
options.hg: Urethra se, jo ek alag chhoti opening hai

explain.en: The urethra is a separate opening just above the vagina. Urine never passes through the vagina, which belongs to the reproductive system.
explain.hg: Urethra vagina ke theek upar ek alag opening hai. Urine kabhi vagina se nahi guzarta, jo reproductive system ka hissa hai.

q.en: After football practice in humid weather, Imran notices an itchy red patch in his groin folds. A friend offers a cream he used last year. What is the best step?
q.hg: Humid weather mein football practice ke baad Imran ko groin folds mein khujli wala laal patch dikhta hai. Ek dost use woh cream deta hai jo usne pichhle saal lagayi thi. Best step kya hai?

options.en: Use the friend's cream twice a day
options.hg: Dost ki cream din mein do baar lagana

options.en: Scrub the area with antiseptic liquid
options.hg: Us jagah ko antiseptic liquid se ragadna

options.en: Keep the area clean and dry, change sweaty underwear, and see a doctor if it does not clear
options.hg: Us jagah ko saaf aur dry rakhna, paseene wala underwear badalna, aur theek na ho toh doctor ko dikhana

explain.en: Sweaty skin folds often get fungal rashes. Borrowed creams may be the wrong kind and some make fungal infections worse, so dryness plus a doctor's advice is safer.
explain.hg: Paseene wale skin folds mein aksar fungal rashes ho jaate hain. Maangi hui cream galat type ki ho sakti hai aur kuch creams fungal infection ko bigaad deti hain, isliye dry rakhna aur doctor ki advice lena zyada safe hai.

q.en: Which combination of symptoms needs medical care on the same day?
q.hg: Symptoms ke kis combination mein usi din doctor ko dikhana zaroori hai?

options.en: Clear, stretchy discharge in the middle of the cycle
options.hg: Cycle ke beech mein clear, stretchy discharge

options.en: One testicle hanging slightly lower than the other
options.hg: Ek testicle ka dusre se thoda neeche latakna

options.en: Burning urination with fever and pain in the back or side
options.hg: Urine mein jalan ke saath bukhaar aur kamar ya side mein dard

explain.en: Fever with back or side pain alongside urinary symptoms can mean the infection has reached the kidneys. The other three are normal variations.
explain.hg: Urine wale symptoms ke saath bukhaar aur kamar ya side mein dard ka matlab ho sakta hai ki infection kidneys tak pahunch gaya hai. Baaki teeno normal variations hain.

q.hg: WHO infertility ko kaise define karta hai?

options.en: No pregnancy after three months of trying
options.hg: Teen mahine ki koshish ke baad pregnancy na hona

options.en: No pregnancy after 12 months or more of regular unprotected intercourse
options.hg: 12 mahine ya usse zyada regular unprotected intercourse ke baad pregnancy na hona

options.en: A low sperm count on a single test
options.hg: Ek hi test mein low sperm count

explain.en: The definition is based on 12 months or more of regular unprotected intercourse without pregnancy. It can involve either partner, so both are assessed.
explain.hg: Definition ka base hai 12 mahine ya usse zyada regular unprotected intercourse ke baad bhi pregnancy na hona. Wajah kisi bhi partner mein ho sakti hai, isliye dono ki jaanch hoti hai.
